## Describe the Bug
Provide a clear and concise description of what the bug is, where it occurs, and when you noticed it.

## Steps to Reproduce
Explain how a developer can reproduce the issue on their machine.
1. Go to the page '...'
2. Click on the element '...'
3. Scroll down to the section '...'
4. Observe the unexpected behavior or error.

## Expected Behavior
Explain what you expected to happen instead of the bug.

## Screenshots or Screen Recordings
If applicable, add screenshots or video links to help explain the problem.

## Environment Details
- Operating System: [e.g. macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox]
- Device or screen size: [e.g. Desktop, iPhone 15, responsive width in px]

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (such as if this only happens when logged in, or when using draft content).
